arxiv-2201-03421.title: Impact of Bidding and Dispatch Models over Energy Storage Utilization in Bulk Power Systems
arxiv-2201-03421.creator: Ningkun Zheng, Bolun Xu
arxiv-2201-03421.description: Abstract Energy storage is a key enabler towards a low-emission electricity system, but requires appropriate dispatch models to be economically coordinated with other generation resources in bulk power systems. This paper analyzes how different dispatch models and bidding strategies would affect the utilization of storage with various durations in deregulated power systems.

arxiv-2207-03931.creator: Chaim Even-Zohar and Joel Hass
arxiv-2207-03931.description: Abstract . We develop a general method for constructing random manifolds and submanifolds in arbitrary dimensions. The method is based on associating colors to the vertices of a triangulated manifold, as in recent work for curves in 3-dimensional space by Sheffield and Yadin (2014). We determine conditions on which submanifolds can arise, in terms of Stiefel–Whitney classes and other properties.

arxiv-2301-07297.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by J.E. Horvath, R. Rosas Fernandes, T.E. IdiartDepartamento de Astronomia, IAG-USP, São Paulo SP, Brazil. We discuss in this work the contradictory position in modern Physics between the existence of a microphysical quantum Reality and macrophysical classical one. After discussing some basic concepts in Philosophy, we revisit the situation of Quantum Mechanics results, particularly after the confirmation of violations of Bell’s Theorem, and its significance to create a tension between the micro and the macro world, which is very fundamental and unsolved.

arxiv-2503-21767.creator: Hairong Yin Huangying Zhan Yi Xu Raymond A. Yeh
arxiv-2503-21767.description: Abstract Open-vocabulary querying in 3D Gaussian Splatting aims to identify semantically relevant regions within a 3D Gaussian representation based on a given text query. Prior work, such as LangSplat, addressed this task by retrieving these regions in the form of segmentation masks on 2D renderings. More recently, OpenGaussian introduced point-level querying, which directly selects a subset of 3D Gaussians.

pmc-11619228.creator: Rian Zanotti, Matteo Sensi, Marcello Berto, Alessandro Paradisi, Michele Bianchi, Pierpaolo Greco, Carlo Augusto Bortolotti, Michele Di Lauro, Fabio Biscarini
pmc-11619228.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A framework for electrolyte‐gated organic transistors (EGOTs) that unifies the view of interfacial capacitive coupling of electrolyte‐gated organic field‐effect transistors (EGOFETs) with the volumetric capacitive coupling in organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs) is proposed. The EGOT effective capacitance arises from in‐series capacitances of the electrolyte/gate electrode and electrolyte/channel interfaces, and the chemical capacitance of the organic semiconductor channel whose weight with respect to the interfacial capacitance is modulated by the charge carrier density, hence by the gate voltage.

pmc-13095761.title: 建立规范的病理和遗传检查以降低死胎发生率
pmc-13095761.creator: Fan ZHOU, Haiyan YU, Wei WANG, Li WAN, Xiaodong WANG
pmc-13095761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 死胎是最严重的不良妊娠结局，是重大公共卫生问题。我国死胎发生率存在显著地区差异，死胎总数仍高居全球第四，在提升死胎规范化管理水平、降低死胎发生率方面仍面临严峻挑战。本文系统综述国际死胎病因分类体系，重点探讨死胎病理学检查关键点和遗传学检测策略，聚焦病理和遗传学检查在死胎病因分类及临床管理中的核心价值，旨在呼吁推动建立符合中国国情的死胎病因分级管理体系，规范和加强死胎的病理和遗传学检查的临床应用，积极识别死胎病因及病理机制，从病因出发预防及降低死胎的发生。Keywords: 死胎, 病因, 病理学, 遗传学, 综述 死胎（Stillbirth）是最严重的不良妊娠结局，是威胁全球妇幼健康的重大公共卫生问题，也是评估国家或地区围产保健质量及医疗水平的关键敏感指标[1]。目前，死胎的定义在不同国家间存在差异，其发生率报道亦呈现较大差别，从发达地区的0.34%到撒哈拉以南非洲地区的2.87%不等[1]。美国国家卫生统计中心（National Center for Health Statistics, NCHS）将死胎定义为妊娠≥20周或胎儿体质量≥350 g，娩出时无任何生命迹象，即无呼吸、无心跳、无脐带搏动及无自主肌肉运动[2-3]。该定义被美国妇产科医师学会（American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists, ACOG）死胎管理指南采纳[3]，我国对死胎亦采用NCHS的死胎诊断标准，并进一步根据胎儿死亡发生时间将分娩前的胎儿宫内死亡称为死胎，分娩过程中的胎儿死亡称为死产[4]。据统计，全球死胎平均发生率约为1.39%，我国死胎发生率报道为0.88%～2.96%，且地区差异明显，中西部地区死胎率显著高于东部地区[1, 5-7]。“消除可预防的死胎”已成为全球妇女儿童健康改善的核心战略之一[1]，加强死胎病因管理、努力降低死胎发生任重而道远。本综述系统梳理了死胎的病因分类，并着重探讨病理学和遗传学检查在其病因分类中的核心价值，旨在提升临床工作者对上述检查的重视程度，为优化死胎的临床管理提供参考。 死胎的病因分类是临床规范化管理的重要基础 死胎应首要关注病因。在充分考虑母体、胎儿、胎盘及脐带等因素和其间交互作用的前提下，对死胎进行归因分析及病理机制研究，积极识别高危因素，指导临床规范化管理路径及再生育风险评估，是降低死胎发生的必由之路。 目前，我国尚未建立统一的死胎病因学分类体系，临床实践仍多依赖孕周进行时间性分类，或在回顾性分析中，依据可获得的信息大致划分为母体、胎儿、胎盘和脐带因素等[4]，难以实现病因精确分类，严重制约了对夫妇再生育的指导价值。作为西部地区危重孕产妇救治中心，四川大学华西第二医院一项纳入了14年间652例死胎的回顾性研究显示，死胎相关因素中母体因素占比最高（57.52%），其次为胎盘因素（26.53%），脐带因素约占10.28%，不明原因占比13.04%[8]。 国际上存在多种死胎病因分类体系（表1）：CODAC体系采用分级框架描述死胎发生的动态过程，有助于理解死胎病因链条，但记录复杂、逻辑要求高[9-10]，与国内临床倾向于单一、直接病因归因的习惯存在差异；ICD-PM将《国际疾病分类第十版》（ICD-10）应用于死胎分类，同时关注胎儿直接死因与母体状况，有利于国际流行病学调查比较和全球疾病负担评估，但其分类规则复杂，对死因链逻辑和信息完整性要求较高[11]，在国内尸检率低、规范化胎盘病理检查未完全普及的现状下[12]，易因关键信息缺失导致分类不准确和“不明原因”占比高；ReCoDe分类聚焦于胎儿死亡的直接病理状况，临床实用性强[13-14]，但无法涵盖国内高发的非致死性胎儿畸形，且在资源有限的医疗机构实施困难；SCRN系统分类简洁、快速易用，在资源有限地区可行性高，但分类相对宽泛，对临床干预的指导价值有限[15]。综上，上述国际主流死胎分类体系临床关注重点及适用场景各异，且均难以在我国直接应用。准确的死胎病因判定高度依赖于规范的病理学和遗传学检查，现阶段全球范围内“不明原因”死胎占比仍居高不下，凸显了相关检查应用不足的现状[16-17]，当前亟待建立基于国内实际情况的死胎病因分类及管理体系，以期优化临床诊疗。 BackgroundPelvic tilt ratio (PTr), defined as pelvic tilt divided by pelvic incidence, may provide an individualized measure of pelvic retroversion in adult spinal deformity (ASD). However, the spinopelvic muscle characteristics associated with different degrees of pelvic retroversion remain unclear.

pmc-13645986.title: Salvage pancreaticoduodenectomy for localized recurrence after resection of ascending colon cancer: a case report
pmc-13645986.creator: Rihito Nagata, Nobuyuki Takemura, Masahiko Komagome, Michio Kogure, Ryosuke Satake, Natsuko Takayanagi, Yasuhiro Nunokawa, Akira Maki, Yoshifumi Beck
pmc-13645986.description: A 66-year-old man underwent right hemicolectomy for ascending colon cancer with direct invasion of gallbladder. Numerous aberrant proliferative vessels from the duodenum were noted. The pathological diagnosis was T4bN0M0, Stage IIC, with a KRAS G12D mutation. He received four cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy.
